description: This PHP source file defines the ViewAdminsettings class, which extends SugarView. It manages the administration settings interface for SugarCRM SuiteCRM, allowing enabling/disabling of SugarFeed modules, processing user input from the admin panel, and rendering the admin settings template.

classes.name: ViewAdminsettings
classes.description: A class extending SugarView that manages the administration settings page for SugarCRM, specifically for SugarFeed module configurations.

methods.name: _getModuleTab
methods.description: Returns the module tab name for the admin settings ('Administration').

methods.name: _getModuleTitleParams
methods.description: Returns parameters for rendering the module title, including a link to the Administration index.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Handles rendering the admin settings page, processing form submissions for enabling/disabling SugarFeed modules, and displaying the current configuration.
